sentences.en: For much of the past year, the war in Ukraine was mostly defined by Ukrainian success.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，乌克兰战争在很大程度上是由乌克兰的成功所定义的。

sentences.en: In battle after battle, Ukraine had unexpectedly and improbably kept winning.
sentences.zh: 在一场又一场的战斗中，乌克兰出人意料且不可思议地不断获胜。

sentences.en: But now, a year in, that momentum has slowed.
sentences.zh: 但一年过去了，这种势头已经放缓。

sentences.en: Russia has hit back, throwing tens of thousands of draftees at the Ukrainian
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯进行了反击，将数以万计的应征入伍者投入到乌克兰的

sentences.en: front lines, causing casualties on both sides to soar and forcing Ukrainians to come to terms with a new reality.
sentences.zh: 前线，导致双方伤亡人数激增，并迫使乌克兰人不得不面对一个新的现实。

sentences.en: That the war is unlikely to be over anytime soon.

sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: So he has like really huge injuries with the many, many, many of that part of the bombs, you know, in his hands, massive bleeding.
sentences.zh: 他的伤势非常严重，手上有很多很多弹片，流血不止。

sentences.en: And we just help him to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 我们把他送到了医院。

sentences.en: But after that, he write me, do you remember me?
sentences.zh: 但后来，他给我写信说，你还记得我吗？

sentences.en: You evocated me.
sentences.zh: 是你把我撤出来的。

sentences.en: So how are you?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗？

sentences.en: I just want to have a video call with you.
sentences.zh: 我想和你视频通话。

sentences.en: And I said, man, no, not today.
sentences.zh: 我说，伙计，不行，今天不行。

sentences.en: No, not today.
sentences.zh: 不，今天不行。

sentences.en: No video calls.
sentences.zh: 不视频通话。

sentences.en: I just evocated you.
sentences.zh: 我只是把你撤出来了而已。

sentences.en: You know, I thought that maybe he wants to have like communication with me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我以为他可能只是想和我套近乎。

sentences.en: And I don't like such things.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢那样。

sentences.en: So that's why I told him, no, no worries.
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉他，不用担心。

sentences.en: See you.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Take care and blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 保重之类的。

sentences.en: So what he said, please, I'm asking you, you need to have a video call with me.
sentences.zh: 他说，求你了，我恳求你，你一定要和我视频通话。

sentences.en: And I said, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 我说，天哪。

sentences.en: Okay, just for a minute.
sentences.zh: 好吧，就一分钟。

sentences.en: And he said, yes.
sentences.zh: 他说，好的。

sentences.en: Okay, just for a minute.
sentences.zh: 好吧，就一分钟。

sentences.en: And he called me and he said, I need to show you somebody.
sentences.zh: 他打给我说，我需要让你看个人。

sentences.en: And he showed me his daughter, six years old daughter.
sentences.zh: 他给我看了他的女儿，六岁大的女儿。

sentences.en: She's like a very tiny girl.
sentences.zh: 她是个非常娇小的女孩。

sentences.en: And she was just smiling to me.
sentences.zh: 她只是对着我笑。

sentences.en: And she just said, hi, Miss Ira.
sentences.zh: 她说，嗨，伊拉小姐。

sentences.en: I just want to tell you thank you for my, that you saved the life of my father.
sentences.zh: 我只想谢谢你救了我爸爸的命。

sentences.en: And that was, oh, my God, very strong moment.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，天哪，真的太震撼了。

sentences.en: Sometimes here in the war, it's, everything is very depressive.
sentences.zh: 有时在这里，在战争中，一切都非常压抑。

sentences.en: But in that moment, all my sadness, tiredness is like just gone.
sentences.zh: 但在那一刻，我所有的悲伤和疲惫都烟消云散了。

sentences.en: And I'm just like staying there and feel that I can, I know why I'm doing this.
sentences.zh: 我站在那里，感觉到我能做到，我知道我为什么要做这些。

sentences.en: And I can do more and more and stay for how much that guys need me.
sentences.zh: 我可以做得更多，只要这些小伙子们需要我，我就能坚持下去。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: When I remember the story, I just feel like I have a sunshine inside of me.
sentences.zh: 每当想起这个故事，我就觉得心里有一束阳光。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You know, after all this month of the war, I just really like feel like I don't have emotions like enough.
sentences.zh: 你知道，经过这几个月的战争，我真的觉得我的情感变得麻木了。

sentences.en: So this is something that war did with me and I really don't like it.
sentences.zh: 这是战争对我做的事，我真的很不喜欢。

sentences.en: I just want to stay that person that I have been before the war.
sentences.zh: 我只想保持战前那个我。

sentences.en: Very easy going.
sentences.zh: 随和开朗。

sentences.en: I had every Friday night with my friends that we, where we drink the wine.
sentences.zh: 我以前每周五晚上都会和朋友们一起喝酒。

sentences.en: And it was, it was perfect life.
sentences.zh: 那曾是完美的生活。

sentences.en: I loved myself and I loved everything that going on, like with everything, with my boyfriends, with my life, with my job, with the Friday nights.
sentences.zh: 我爱我自己，爱我生活中的一切，我的男朋友、我的生活、我的工作、我的周五之夜。

sentences.en: And it was, it was, it was, um, the person I loved, it was me.
sentences.zh: 那个人，我爱的那个人，就是我自己。

sentences.en: And I don't know if it's clear right now to understand, but I'm, I'm telling you this and I'm smiling right now because that was crazy.
sentences.zh: 我不知道现在说这些是否清楚，但我现在说着说着就笑了，因为那段日子太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Perfect life.
sentences.zh: 完美的生活。

sentences.en: Now I'm just want to come back and to feel the same, to feel all this, um, perfect things from, um, living life.
sentences.zh: 现在我只想回到过去，感受同样的感觉，感受生活中所有这些美好的事物。

sentences.en: This is, that's why I love this, this, this life.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我热爱生活。

sentences.en: And I just sometimes feel very lonely because of this, because I come back to my parents' cities where I have had a lot of friends and we had coffee together.
sentences.zh: 有时我感到非常孤独，因为我回到父母所在的城市，那里曾有很多朋友，我们曾一起喝咖啡。

sentences.en: And I said to my mom, I said, here, you know, I just, I don't know how I can ask somebody to go with, to have a coffee with me because everybody's died.
sentences.zh: 我对我妈说，你知道，我不知道该怎么约人出来喝咖啡，因为大家都死了。

sentences.en: You said to your mom, how can I ask somebody to have coffee with me?
sentences.zh: 你对你妈说，我该怎么约人出来喝咖啡？

sentences.en: Everybody's died.
sentences.zh: 大家都死了。

sentences.en: You mean because so many of your friends had died?
sentences.zh: 你是说因为你的很多朋友都牺牲了？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm, exactly, yes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正是如此。

sentences.en: And I just, like, don't have, don't know whom I can ask for this.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道还能约谁。

sentences.en: About how many of your friends died in this war era?
sentences.zh: 伊拉，在这场战争中，你有多少朋友牺牲了？

sentences.en: Um, if we can say from the, um, 2014, uh, I guess it can be, um,
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果从2014年算起，我想大概有……

sentences.en: Um, 16th person.
sentences.zh: 16个人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, I hear that's a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 噢，我听说那可是很多人。

sentences.en: Yes, yes, that, that's, that's, like, something that, um, hurt me the most in this war.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，这就是在这场战争中，最让我心痛的事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is the feeling, like, people of my age.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉，就像是同龄人（的离去）。

sentences.en: This is very hard to explain, like, feeling that I lose, um, my youngest, yes, I don't know how, I know the word.
sentences.zh: 这很难解释，那种失去我最年轻的……我不知道怎么说，我知道那个词。

sentences.en: Feeling that you lose your youth.
sentences.zh: 感觉你失去了青春。

sentences.en: Yes, my youngest, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的青春，是的。

sentences.en: Just a moment.
sentences.zh: 等一下。

sentences.en: Okay, just a moment.
sentences.zh: 好的，等一下。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Just let me answer my commander.
sentences.zh: 让我回复一下我的指挥官。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It sounds like you need to go.
sentences.zh: 听起来你得走了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm very sorry, but I need to say to my team that we will have a new task.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，但我得告诉我的团队，我们有新任务了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Ira, thank you so much for talking to me.
sentences.zh: 伊拉，非常感谢你接受我的采访。

sentences.en: It's nothing.
sentences.zh: 没什么。

sentences.en: Good luck.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 你好，奥尔加。

sentences.en: It's Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: Yeah, hi.
sentences.zh: 噢，你好。

sentences.en: Hello, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 你好，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: So, Olga, let's begin.
sentences.zh: 那么，奥尔加，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Tell me your name, your age, and where you are right now.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你的名字、年龄，以及你现在在哪里。

sentences.en: My name is Olga Berzul, and I'm 40 years.
sentences.zh: 我叫奥尔加·贝尔祖尔，今年40岁。

sentences.en: I'm currently based in Vienna.
sentences.zh: 我目前住在维也纳。

sentences.en: Because, as you know, Ukraine is still under shelling.
sentences.zh: 因为如你所知，乌克兰仍处于炮火之下。

sentences.en: And I gave a promise to my husband that I will protect our daughter.
sentences.zh: 我曾向丈夫承诺过，我会保护好我们的女儿。

sentences.en: She's nine years old.
sentences.zh: 她今年九岁。

sentences.en: Her name is Zacharia.
sentences.zh: 她叫扎哈里亚。

sentences.en: And he asked me to stay for a while somewhere in a safe place.
sentences.zh: 他请求我暂时待在一个安全的地方。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Olga, I'm going to ask you some questions about Victor.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加，我想问你一些关于维克多（Victor）的问题。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: How did you meet, you and Victor?
sentences.zh: 你和维克多是怎么认识的？

sentences.en: We actually meet on the 1st of January, and it was a very funny story because Victor called me.
sentences.zh: 其实我们是在1月1日认识的，那是个非常有趣的故事，因为是维克多打给我的。

sentences.en: We had mutual friends, and he got my number, but we actually haven't seen each other at all.
sentences.zh: 我们有共同的朋友，他拿到了我的号码，但我们当时其实还没见过面。

sentences.en: We just heard something about it.
sentences.zh: 我们只是听说过彼此。

sentences.en: And I even don't know.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不知道。

sentences.en: I asked him why he decided to call me.
sentences.zh: 我问他为什么决定打给我。

sentences.en: He told me, I actually can't explain.
sentences.zh: 他说，其实我也解释不清楚。

sentences.en: And I just had your number, and they told me, why not?
sentences.zh: 我只是刚好有你的号码，他们就跟我说，为什么不打呢？

sentences.en: And just called.
sentences.zh: 然后就打了。

sentences.en: And like, hi, what about meeting?
sentences.zh: 就像是，嗨，要不要见个面？

sentences.en: I had some champagne.
sentences.zh: 我当时喝了点香槟。

sentences.en: What about meeting?
sentences.zh: 要不要见个面？

sentences.en: And I said, it's a joke.
sentences.zh: 我说，你在开玩笑吧。

sentences.en: And they said, yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 他们说，是啊，当然。

sentences.en: He just came to my flat.
sentences.zh: 他就直接来了我的公寓。

sentences.en: And I was surprised because I said, it was a joke.
sentences.zh: 我很惊讶，因为我说过，那只是个玩笑。

sentences.en: And actually, yeah.
sentences.zh: 但其实，嗯。

sentences.en: And like, we talked a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了很多。

sentences.en: We laughed a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们笑得很开心。

sentences.en: We were kids.
sentences.zh: 我们当时还是孩子。

sentences.en: We were 23 years old.
sentences.zh: 我们才23岁。

sentences.en: And as usual, you need some time to understand that this guy is good for you.
sentences.zh: 像往常一样，你需要一些时间去了解这个人是否适合你。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But like, I was really surprised that we have so many common favorite things.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很惊讶，我们竟然有那么多共同的爱好。

sentences.en: I mean, music, film, books, art.
sentences.zh: 我是说，音乐、电影、书籍、艺术。

sentences.en: And like, after that, we just started to meet each other.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我们就开始交往了。

sentences.en: And very fast, we actually started to live together.
sentences.zh: 很快，我们就开始同居了。

sentences.en: And after eight years, I just asked, what are you thinking about having a baby?
sentences.zh: 八年后，我问他，你有没有考虑过要个孩子？

sentences.en: Because like, eight years is quite long.
sentences.zh: 因为八年已经是很长的一段时间了。

sentences.en: And he told me that I think that having a baby is a very good idea.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，我觉得要个孩子是个非常好的主意。

sentences.en: And yes, we were very happy young parents.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们曾是一对非常幸福的年轻父母。

sentences.en: Because like, it was a kind of adventure for us.
sentences.zh: 因为那对我们来说就像是一场冒险。

sentences.en: And tell me your occupation, your job before the war.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你的职业，战争前你的工作。

sentences.en: I'm actually a film curator.
sentences.zh: 我其实是一名电影策展人。

sentences.en: I've organized a film festival.
sentences.zh: 我组织过电影节。

sentences.en: And Vita, he was a film editor on different artistic filMs.
sentences.zh: 维塔（Vita）曾是不同艺术电影的电影剪辑师。

sentences.en: And actually, it was a quite strong glue for us.
sentences.zh: 那其实是我们之间非常强有力的纽带。

sentences.en: Because it's like our, how to say it, our air.
sentences.zh: 因为那就像我们的，怎么说呢，我们的空气。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It was quite popular activity for us to spend our evenings by discussing different films and our impressions.
sentences.zh: 我们很喜欢在晚上讨论不同的电影和我们的观感。

sentences.en: And actually, sometimes we had different opinions.
sentences.zh: 其实，有时我们会有不同的意见。

sentences.en: And for us, it was quite, you know, usual thing to fight because of the filMs.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，因为电影而争吵是很平常的事。

sentences.en: Because we had a joke that normal families, as usual, fight trying to find proper refrigerator.
sentences.zh: 我们曾开玩笑说，普通的家庭通常是为了买冰箱而吵架。

sentences.en: But we, instead of it, fight to find the common impressions regarding the film.
sentences.zh: 而我们，取而代之的是为了对电影的看法而争论。

sentences.en: But then, as you know, when the war started, Vita told me that he would go to this military, recruiting military services.
sentences.zh: 但后来，如你所知，战争爆发时，维塔告诉我他要去参军，去应征入伍。

sentences.en: And he told me that, of course, he feels fear and it's normal.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他当然会感到恐惧，这很正常。

sentences.en: But it's not like that point of history when he can wait and to hesitate.
sentences.zh: 但这不是他可以等待或犹豫的历史时刻。

sentences.en: And then, he was sent to the war.
sentences.zh: 然后，他就被派往战场了。

sentences.en: And after that, it's very important not to panic during the communication with your husband when he is at war.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，在丈夫参战时与他沟通，保持冷静非常重要。

sentences.en: Because it's quite difficult for them to stay there.
sentences.zh: 因为他们在那里过得很艰难。

sentences.en: They don't sleep.
sentences.zh: 他们无法入睡。

sentences.en: They can't eat normally.
sentences.zh: 他们无法正常进食。

sentences.en: They're under pressure all the time.
sentences.zh: 他们时刻承受着压力。

sentences.en: And when you explain to your husband that you are worried, that you are in anxiety, that you can't sleep, it doesn't help them to fight.
sentences.zh: 当你向丈夫倾诉你的担忧、焦虑和失眠时，这对他作战毫无帮助。

sentences.en: And actually, I also was trying to talk with him about books, literature, history, and especially filMs.
sentences.zh: 其实，我也试着和他聊书籍、文学、历史，尤其是电影。

sentences.en: We have one favorite film, which is called Apocalypse Now, which is made by Coppola.
sentences.zh: 我们有一部最喜欢的电影，叫《现代启示录》，是科波拉导演的。

sentences.en: And Vita told me that he definitely would have another impression of the film after this war experience.
sentences.zh: 维塔告诉我，经历过这场战争后，他肯定会对这部电影有不同的感悟。

sentences.en: That the film can express all that human being experienced in war line.
sentences.zh: 这部电影能表达出人类在战线上所经历的一切。

sentences.en: And he told me that it's quite important for him to hear all these pieces of previous life, this peaceful life.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，对他来说，听到这些关于过去生活、这种和平生活的点滴非常重要。

sentences.en: Because it helps him to believe that war is not only the reality in which he now exists.
sentences.zh: 因为这能让他相信，战争并不是他现在所处的唯一现实。

sentences.en: And during this nine months in war, we only had one chance to see each other.
sentences.zh: 在这九个月的战争期间，我们只有一次见面的机会。

sentences.en: It was at the end of AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 那是在八月底。

sentences.en: I had my birthday.
sentences.zh: 那是我的生日。

sentences.en: I had my 40th.
sentences.zh: 我40岁了。

sentences.en: Your 40th.
sentences.zh: 你40岁了。

sentences.en: Your 40th, yeah.
sentences.zh: 你40岁了，是啊。

sentences.en: And I asked Vita to find like a day or two to meet us.
sentences.zh: 我请求维塔挤出一两天时间来见我们。

sentences.en: And we met in Rivene.
sentences.zh: 我们在里夫内见了面。

sentences.en: I came from Vienna.
sentences.zh: 我从维也纳赶来。

sentences.en: We spent together three days.
sentences.zh: 我们在一起待了三天。

sentences.en: And it was a very happy moment in my life because I took my daughter.
sentences.zh: 那是我生命中非常幸福的时刻，因为我带上了我的女儿。

sentences.en: And it was actually our last meeting.
sentences.zh: 那其实是我们最后一次见面。

sentences.en: It was 20th of AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 那是8月20日。

sentences.en: It was a sunny and warm, beautiful day.
sentences.zh: 那是一个阳光明媚、温暖美好的日子。

sentences.en: And I was in a bus when I saw him.
sentences.zh: 我在公交车上看到了他。

sentences.en: And my daughter, Zaharia, saw him.
sentences.zh: 我的女儿扎哈里亚也看到了他。

sentences.en: Actually, we ran to him and hugged him.
sentences.zh: 我们跑向他，拥抱了他。

sentences.en: He was with this flower, with this sunflower, you know, this our traditional flower.
sentences.zh: 他拿着那朵花，向日葵，你知道的，那是我们的传统花卉。

sentences.en: And he was in his military form.
sentences.zh: 他穿着军装。

sentences.en: And we were very, very happy.
sentences.zh: 我们当时非常非常开心。

sentences.en: But actually, it was a little bit difficult because like you all the time want to cry.
sentences.zh: 但其实有点难受，因为你时刻都想哭。

sentences.en: But you can't because you don't want to cry during these three days.
sentences.zh: 但你不能哭，因为你不想在这三天里哭泣。

sentences.en: Like because you don't know when you will have this meeting will happen again.
sentences.zh: 因为你不知道下一次见面会是什么时候。

sentences.en: And so we went to the park.
sentences.zh: 于是我们去了公园。

sentences.en: We played with our daughter a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们和女儿玩得很开心。

sentences.en: And then actually, we also went to the cinema, of course, because for us it's important because cinema is a part of our life.
sentences.zh: 然后我们还去看了电影，当然，因为这对我们很重要，电影是我们生活的一部分。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we watched a very strange entertainment film because, as usual, we watch art house filMs.
sentences.zh: 我们看了一部非常奇怪的娱乐片，因为我们平时都看艺术电影。

sentences.en: But at that moment, it had no matter what kind of film.
sentences.zh: 但在那一刻，看什么电影已经不重要了。

sentences.en: For us, it was a desire to catch this feeling of our normal life before the Russian invasion.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，我们渴望捕捉那种俄罗斯入侵前正常生活的感觉。

sentences.en: And it was a little bit surrealistic feeling that, you know, the ordinary life is surrounding you.
sentences.zh: 那是一种超现实的感觉，你知道，周围都是平凡的生活。

sentences.en: So, kids, young families, teenagers, and among all this normal reality, you and your husband in the military form, you know that war is going on.
sentences.zh: 孩子们、年轻家庭、青少年，而在这一切正常的现实中，你和穿着军装的丈夫在一起，你知道战争正在进行。

sentences.en: But in this part of Ukraine, you can't feel it because it's not on the front line.
sentences.zh: 但在乌克兰的这个地方，你感觉不到，因为它不在前线。

sentences.en: And only the sounds of sirens somehow remind you that it's war.
sentences.zh: 只有警报声在提醒你，战争还在继续。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I was, like, counting all the time, the minutes and hours to the end of our meeting because I knew that we had two and a half days.
sentences.zh: 我一直在倒数我们相聚的分钟和小时，因为我知道我们只有两天半的时间。

sentences.en: And, as you know, the time ran very faSt.
sentences.zh: 而且，如你所知，时间过得非常快。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And then, it was December.
sentences.zh: 然后，到了十二月。

sentences.en: It was cold.
sentences.zh: 天气很冷。

sentences.en: It was difficult.
sentences.zh: 日子很难熬。

sentences.en: But he told me that he's trying to be strong.
sentences.zh: 但他告诉我，他会努力坚强。

sentences.en: That he's really believed that he will come back home.
sentences.zh: 他真的相信他会回家。

sentences.en: That he will hold me and Zaharia.
sentences.zh: 他会拥抱我和扎哈里亚。

sentences.en: That I should believe that he will come back.
sentences.zh: 我应该相信他会回来。

sentences.en: And sometimes he even apologized that he can't support me at this moment, that he had to be on the war.
sentences.zh: 有时他甚至会道歉，说他此刻无法支持我，因为他必须在战场上。

sentences.en: He never told me anything about the chance of his death.
sentences.zh: 他从未跟我提过他可能会牺牲的事。

sentences.en: He always told me that he will come back.
sentences.zh: 他总是告诉我他会回来。

sentences.en: And he promised me that everything will be okay in the future.
sentences.zh: 他向我保证未来一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: That I have to believe in this.
sentences.zh: 我必须相信这一点。

sentences.en: So, 30th of December, I wrote him in the morning and didn't receive anything.
sentences.zh: 所以，12月30日那天，我早上给他发了信息，但没有收到任何回复。

sentences.en: And during the whole day, I was sending him messages.
sentences.zh: 整整一天，我都在给他发消息。

sentences.en: Peter, please send me this plus, just something.
sentences.zh: 维塔，请给我回个加号，什么都行。

sentences.en: Tell me because you do not answer me.
sentences.zh: 告诉我一声，因为你没回我。

sentences.en: And I had this terrible feeling that maybe something happened.
sentences.zh: 我有一种可怕的预感，可能出事了。

sentences.en: And then, in the evening, I got a call from a soldier.
sentences.zh: 然后，晚上我接到了一个士兵的电话。

sentences.en: And he told me that Vita died.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我维塔牺牲了。

sentences.en: Because he, I even can say that he died because of this missile attack.
sentences.zh: 因为他，我甚至可以说他是死于那次导弹袭击。

sentences.en: When I got this call, it was maybe the most terrible and terrifying call in my life.
sentences.zh: 接到那个电话时，那可能是我一生中最可怕、最恐怖的时刻。

sentences.en: I had also to tell this news to my daughter, then to Vita's parents, to my parents, to Vita's sister.
sentences.zh: 我还得把这个消息告诉我的女儿，然后是维塔的父母、我的父母，还有维塔的姐姐。

sentences.en: And on the 1st of January, we celebrate our anniversary.
sentences.zh: 1月1日是我们结婚纪念日。

sentences.en: So, like, in two days, we should celebrate the 17-year anniversary.
sentences.zh: 所以，再过两天，我们本该庆祝结婚17周年纪念日。

sentences.en: And now, I will never have a new year anymore.
sentences.zh: 现在，我再也不会有新年了。

sentences.en: I think I will never have this celebration again.
sentences.zh: 我想我再也不会庆祝这个节日了。

sentences.en: And the next day, I got this message.
sentences.zh: 第二天，我收到了这条信息。

sentences.en: Vita sent his friend Sasha a message when he was alive.
sentences.zh: 这是维塔生前发给他朋友萨沙（Sasha）的信息。

sentences.en: When Vita was on the front line on the south of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 当时维塔还在乌克兰南部的战线上。

sentences.en: And in this message, Vita asked Sasha to tell me and Zaharia that Vita loves us.
sentences.zh: 在这条信息里，维塔请萨沙转告我和扎哈里亚，维塔爱我们。

sentences.en: That he always will be with us.
sentences.zh: 他会永远和我们在一起。

sentences.en: That he actually was right to go to the front line and to defend Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他其实是对的，去前线保卫乌克兰是正确的选择。

sentences.en: And that he asked Sasha to tell me that Vita loves me because he can't send this message to me in order not to make me panic, you know.
sentences.zh: 他让萨莎转告我维塔爱我，因为他不能直接发信息给我，以免让我惊慌，你知道的。

sentences.en: Because he still all the time tried to create the atmosphere that he will come back.
sentences.zh: 因为他一直都在营造一种他会回来的氛围。

sentences.en: And then I was in a train.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在火车上。

sentences.en: I was moving to Kiev to organize a funeral and so on.
sentences.zh: 我正赶往基辅去筹备葬礼等等事宜。

sentences.en: And we played his favorite songs with dance, with hugs.
sentences.zh: 我们放着他最喜欢的歌，跳着舞，拥抱着。

sentences.en: It was, like, very crazy.
sentences.zh: 那感觉真是太疯狂了。

sentences.en: But I know that he wanted to have a party because in his taxes, he also told me that when he comes back, there will be a good party.
sentences.zh: 但我知道他想办一场派对，因为他在短信里也跟我说过，等他回来，要办一场盛大的派对。

sentences.en: And we will dance in order to recover after this shocking and bloody war.
sentences.zh: 我们要跳舞，好在这场令人震惊且血腥的战争之后恢复过来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的消息。

sentences.en: A new report issued Thursday by the National Transportation Safety Board confirmed that the derailment of a Norfolk Southern train in East Palestine, Ohio,
sentences.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会周四发布的一份新报告证实，诺福克南方铁路公司的一列火车在俄亥俄州东巴勒斯坦城脱轨，

sentences.en: carrying hazardous chemicals, was caused by a wheel bearing that overheated.
sentences.zh: 是因为车轮轴承过热导致的，而车上载有危险化学品。

sentences.en: The train derailed earlier this month and the hazardous gases on board were burned off to avoid the threat of an explosion.
sentences.zh: 这列火车在本月初脱轨，为了避免爆炸威胁，车上的危险气体被排空焚烧。

sentences.en: Since then, federal and state officials have said tests have found the water and air to be safe to breathe and drink.
sentences.zh: 此后，联邦和州政府官员表示，检测结果显示水和空气可以安全饮用和呼吸。

sentences.en: But residents continue to report an array of lingering symptoms and have questions about whether it will be safe to continue to live there in the long term.
sentences.zh: 但当地居民仍不断报告出现各种挥之不去的症状，并质疑长期居住在那里是否安全。

sentences.en: And former film producer Harvey Weinstein was sentenced to 16 years in prison Thursday for committing sex crimes in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 前电影制片人哈维·温斯坦周四因在洛杉矶犯下性犯罪，被判处16年监禁。

sentences.en: He'll serve the sentence on top of the 23-year term he received in New York in 2020.
sentences.zh: 他将在服完2020年在纽约被判的23年刑期之后，继续服这16年刑期。

sentences.en: Thursday's sentencing all but ensures the 70-year-old will spend the rest of his life in prison.
sentences.zh: 周四的判决几乎确保了这位70岁的老人将在监狱中度过余生。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Claire Tennisgetter, Shannon Lynn, Rob Zipko, and Nina Feldman.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由克莱尔·坦尼斯盖特、香农·林恩、罗伯·齐普科和尼娜·费尔德曼制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Liz O'Balen with help from Lisa Chow.
sentences.zh: 由莉兹·奥巴伦编辑，丽莎·周提供协助。

sentences.en: It contains original music by Marian Lozano, Rowan Nemisto, and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Corey Schreppel.
sentences.zh: 节目包含玛丽安·洛萨诺、罗文·内米斯托和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，并由科里·施雷佩尔负责工程制作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Natalia Yermak, Carlotta Gall, and Andrew Kramer.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢娜塔莉亚·叶尔马克、卡洛塔·加尔和安德鲁·克莱默。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderland的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我，莎拉·凯尼格，将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在你收听播客的任何平台订阅收听。
